channel.title: Mitesh Gandhi | Reflections
channel.description: Weekly reflections from an optometrist on the art of seeing, and being seen.

item.title: For most of my childhood, I wanted to disappear
item.description: At four years old, white patches began to appear around my eyes and across my body. Today I spend my working days looking into people's eyes, and I've learned that looking and seeing are not the same thing.
